pages.text: 200 HP, 12 armor. A giant knight whose blade withers. It $(l)dashes$() at distant targets and calls two Withered Knights at 66% and 33% health. Guards the Withered Catacombs.

$(li)$(l)Spectral sweep$(): wide arc in front of him, inflicts Wither II. Stay behind him.$(li)$(l)Soul chains$(): pulls back players who flee and slows them.$(li)$(l)Soul dash$() toward distant targets.$(li)Below 50%: $(l)bone spikes$() burst in two rings around him. Back away!
pages.title: Tactique
